ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Investigative Reporting for Print, Broadcast and Digital Journalism. Please note the stated prerequistes. The registration system may allow you to select this course even if you do not meet prerequisites. You may be dropped when the pre-reqs are checked or will have to get permission from the professor to attend. Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Journalism or News-Editorial or Broadcast Journalism major (s).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Journalism or News-Editorial or Broadcast Journalism major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
